scope: Every entry under repository root, including hidden, archive, work and vendor files; symlinks inventoried without following targets
limits: Checksums establish a new inventory; no previous checksum exists for every upstream or historical file.
Whole-file byte reads are not a semantic or vulnerability review of all third-party source.
Symlink targets are recorded and checked; external trees are not traversed.
No device writes or fresh physical qualification.
Inventory snapshot precedes creation of this report and its private audit copies.

findings.detail: 142 unresolved symlinks under work/build; QEMU and musl build trees require regeneration or explicit adaptation before reuse. Successful PW3 candidate builds used separately prepared dependencies.
Four experiment links retain historical source paths; 1223 archived-rootfs links do not resolve against the host; one archived QEMU monitor socket. Retained without modification.
